Fairfield-Gutzeit House Bath, Ontario was built in 1796. This Canadian House was one of the first houses ever built in Ontario & one of the oldest in Canada 🇨🇦 with the beautiful unreal view of Lake Ontario the sunsets cast unreal orange, lavender, pink & yellow light on the clouds. 📸 Angela McEwen

That little patch of icey blue above Lake Ontario? Right over where I live and continue to shiver.

The "Wintering Site" National Historic Site of Canada at Donjon Boulevard in Port Dover, Ontario marks where René Bréhant de Galinée and François Dollier de Casson, along with seven other Frenchmen, wintered in 1669-1670. A cross nearby marks where they claimed the Lake Erie region for France.
